reels.title: How to make this viral dog dance ai video
prompts:
Image prompt 
Create an ultra-realistic, funny anthropomorphic version of a normal pet dog, standing upright on two hind legs like a human in a traditional Indian village farm. The dog should have its original natural breed, face, fur color, and recognizable features preserved. Give the dog a playful, confident expression with its tongue slightly out, one front paw raised to its forehead in a funny salute, and the other paw resting on its waist. Dress it in a colorful traditional Indian gamcha tied around its waist, with bright orange, yellow, and pink fabric flowing naturally. Background: a beautiful rural Indian farm with wooden fencing, a brown cow, a few chickens, green grass, a hay shed, and a large shady tree. Warm golden-hour sunlight, realistic fur texture, natural shadows, cinematic depth of field, detailed paws, lifelike anatomy, professional photography, highly detailed, 4K quality, vertical 9:16 composition, full body visible, realistic environment, humorous viral social media video aesthetic. No text, no watermark, no cartoon, no illustration.

Video prompt 
"A pug dog standing on its hind legs wearing a colorful cloth wrap, dancing expressively and fastly in a sad, dramatic Bollywood style, perfectly synchronized to a melancholic Hindi song. The dog should have human-like movements and facial expressions conveying heartbreak. Background is a rural farm setting with cows, chickens, and a rustic hut."

reels.title: Make this viral profile clean ai video
prompts:
Image prompt :
Create an ultra-realistic, high-quality 9:16 vertical Instagram creator profile poster using the two uploaded reference images.

REFERENCE 1 — MY PERSONAL PHOTO: Use my exact face, hairstyle, skin tone, facial features, and identity. Preserve my natural appearance without beautification or facial changes.

REFERENCE 2 — MY INSTAGRAM PROFILE SCREENSHOT: Recreate my Instagram profile interface accurately, including my username, profile picture, bio, follower count, post count, following count, dashboard, profile buttons, and visible post thumbnails. Keep all profile details consistent with the uploaded screenshot. Do not invent new statistics or change my username.

COMPOSITION: Place my Instagram profile screenshot as the full-screen background, resembling a real Instagram profile page on a clean white interface. Position a realistic, full-body cutout of me standing confidently in the center foreground, overlapping the profile interface and post grid. My entire body should be visible from head to shoes, with natural proportions and realistic edges.

OUTFIT: A stylish blue-and-white color-block jacket, plain black T-shirt, relaxed-fit black jeans, and white sneakers. Hands inside pockets, relaxed confident posture, looking directly at the camera. Adapt the outfit to my reference photo if needed.

LIGHTING & QUALITY: Professional studio lighting, realistic skin texture, sharp facial details, natural shadows beneath my shoes, premium creator branding, crisp Instagram UI, photorealistic compositing, HDR, 4K quality.

IMPORTANT: Preserve my exact identity. Keep the Instagram screenshot recognizable and readable. Do not distort the face, hands, body proportions, profile layout, or thumbnails. No extra text, no watermark, no additional logos, no unnecessary objects. Make it look like a professionally edited creator profile poster, not an AI-generated collage.

Video prompt 1:
A miniature version of me climbs down from profile pic and wipes off and cleans the profile usina cloth. Seamless movements. Clean whole of the profile pic in the backaround

Video prompt 2:
He decorates the profile in background and decorates the floor with garlands the picks up a pumpkin and perform aarti

reels.title: How to make this viral car effect
prompts: "First-person POV (Point of View), jisme ek vyakti ne black leather gloves pehne hue hain. Scene ek khule, flat safed desert (salt flat) me hai jiske upar saaf neela aasmaan hai. Aasmaan se car ke alag-alag parts tezi se niche ki taraf gir rahe hain. Vyakti achanak apne dono haath aage karta hai aur saare car ke parts hawa me hi freeze ho jaate hain. Phir vyakti apni mutthi band karta hai aur haath apni taraf kichta hai, jisse saare parts tezi se ek saath judkar ek sleek, silver futuristic car me assemble ho jaate hain. Aakhir me, vyakti ke haath me ek car ki chabi aati hai, wo button dabata hai, aur car ki headlights on ho jaati hain."
